_comment: Question bank for the 'Model reliability report' in the live viewer. Mostly items a small-to-mid model is actually likely to get wrong sometimes: classic cognitive-reflection-test traps (the intuitive answer is wrong), order-of-operations, multi-digit arithmetic, letter-counting, and a few common-misconception facts. A few easy recall items stay as a sanity floor. All correct/other pairs use short, canonical (ideally numeric) answers so probes.pick_answer stays reliable - questions are phrased to elicit a bare number where possible.

items.question: Is 51 a prime number or a composite number?
A bat and a ball cost $1.10 in total. The bat costs $1.00 more than the ball. How many cents does the ball cost? Answer with just the number.
If it takes 5 machines 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, how many minutes would it take 100 machines to make 100 widgets? Answer with just the number.
